text: [107] pañcahi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu āhuneyyo hoti pāhuneyyo dakkhiṇeyyo añjalikaraṇīyo anuttaraṃ( puññakkhettaṃ lokassa katamehi pañcahi idha bhikkhave bhikkhu sīlasampanno hoti samādhisampanno hoti paññāsampanno hoti vimuttisampanno hoti vimuttiñāṇadassanasampanno hoti imehi kho bhikkhave pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu āhuneyyo hoti pāhuneyyo dakkhiṇeyyo añjalikaraṇīyo anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassāti .
